arxiv-2105-13501.title: Hardware-Efficient, Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation with Rydberg Atoms
arxiv-2105-13501.creator: Iris Cong, Harry Levine, Alexander Keesling, Dolev Bluvstein, Sheng-Tao Wang, Mikhail D. Lukin
arxiv-2105-13501.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Iris Cong, Harry Levine, Alexander Keesling, Dolev Bluvstein, Sheng-Tao Wang, Mikhail D. Lukin. Neutral atom arrays have recently emerged as a promising platform for quantum information processing. One important remaining roadblock for the large-scale application of these systems is the ability to perform error-corrected quantum operations. To entangle the qubits in these systems, atoms are typically excited to Rydberg states, which could decay or give rise to various correlated errors that cannot be addressed directly through traditional methods of fault-tolerant quantum computation.

arxiv-2107-05904.title: Region attention and graph embedding network for occlusion objective class-based micro-expression recognition
arxiv-2107-05904.creator: Qirong Mao, Ling Zhou, Wenming Zheng, Xiuyan Shao, Xiaohua Huang
arxiv-2107-05904.description: Abstract Micro-expression recognition ( MER ) has attracted lots of researchers’ attention in a decade. However, occlusion will occur for MER in real-world scenarios. This paper deeply investigates an interesting but unexplored challenging issue in MER, i.e. , occlusion MER. First, to research MER under real-world occlusion, synthetic occluded micro-expression databases are created by using various mask for the community.

arxiv-2108-00614.title: Simple Framework of ZF Precoding Analysis for Full-Dimensional Massive MIMO Systems
arxiv-2108-00614.creator: Harsh Tataria*, Mansoor Shafi*Ericsson AB, Lund, Sweden
arxiv-2108-00614.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Harsh Tataria*, Mansoor Shafi*Ericsson AB, Lund, Sweden. We provide a simple, yet general and accurate framework for analyzing zero-forcing (ZF) precoding performance for a full-dimensional massive multiple-input multiple-output system. Exploiting an order two Neumann series, our framework approximates the expected (average) ZF signal-to-noise ratio and ergodic sum spectral efficiency, while catering for a finite multipath propagation model, as well as correlated and uncorrelated user equipment (UE) positions in both azimuth and elevation domains.

arxiv-2201-11188.title: Crystal structure prediction with machine learning-based element substitution Journal: Computational Materials Science
arxiv-2201-11188.creator: Minoru Kusaba, Chang Liu, Ryo Yoshida
arxiv-2201-11188.description: Abstract The prediction of energetically stable crystal structures formed by a given chemical composition is a central problem in solid-state physics. In principle, the crystalline state of assembled atoms can be determined by optimizing the energy surface, which in turn can be evaluated using first-principles calculations.

arxiv-2407-13450.title: Sparse Nullstellensatz, resultants and determinants of complexes
arxiv-2407-13450.creator: Carlos D’Andrea, Gabriela Jeronimo
arxiv-2407-13450.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Carlos D’Andrea, Gabriela Jeronimo. We refine and extend a result by Tuitman on the supports of a Bézout identity satisfied by a finite sequence of sparse Laurent polynomials without common zeroes in the toric variety associated to their supports. When the number of these polynomials is one more than the dimension of the ambient space, we obtain a formula for computing the sparse resultant as the determinant of a Koszul type complex. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2412-20252.creator: S. N. Storchak
arxiv-2412-20252.description: Abstract Based on a method developed earlier for a finite-dimensional mechanical system, the problem of path integral reduction for scalar electrodynamics is considered. Using the Coulomb gauge, the stochastic differential equations for the reduced dynamics on the orbit space are obtained.

arxiv-2505-10975.title: Survey of End-to-End Multi-Speaker Automatic Speech Recognition for Monaural Audio
arxiv-2505-10975.creator: Xinlu He, Jacob Whitehill
arxiv-2505-10975.description: Abstract Monaural multi-speaker automatic speech recognition (ASR) remains challenging due to data scarcity and the intrinsic difficulty of recognizing and attributing words to individual speakers, particularly in overlapping speech. Recent advances have driven the shift from cascade systems to end-to-end (E2E) architectures, which reduce error propagation and better exploit the synergy between speech content and speaker identity.

pmc-11508802.title: Assessment of Surface Sterilisation Approaches for the Removal of Pollen DNA from Philaenus spumarius
pmc-11508802.creator: Sam McGreig, Hollie Pufal, Chris Conyers, Eleanor P Jones, Edward Haynes, Muhammad Ashfaq, Mauro Mandrioli
pmc-11508802.description: Simple SummaryTo reliably identify the gut contents of plant-feeding insects, the removal of contaminant plant DNA from the insect surface is necessary. Previous approaches have used bleach and alcohol washes to achieve this. We perform a controlled baseline study on a herbivorous insect, the Meadow Spittlebug (Philaenus spumarius), to identify possible contamination that may persist after bleach washes.

pmc-11525649.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury (MIRI) poses a prevalent challenge in current reperfusion therapies, with an absence of efficacious interventions to address the underlying causes.AIMTo investigate whether the extracellular vesicles (EVs) secreted by adipose mesenchymal stem cells (ADSCs) derived from subcutaneous inguinal adipose tissue (IAT) under γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) induction (GABA-EVsIAT) demonstrate a more pronounced inhibitory effect on mitochondrial oxidative stress and elucidate the underlying mechanisms.METHODSWe investigated the potential protective effects of EVs derived from mouse ADSCs pretreated with GABA.

pmc-11647925.title: The summary of risk response on radioactive substances contained in food items in the aftermath of the Fukushima nuclear accident
pmc-11647925.creator: Naomi Hayashida, Itsuko Horiguchi
pmc-11647925.description: The Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant accident occurred after the Great East Japan Earthquake on 11 March 2011. The regulations for food items contaminated with radioiodine or radioactive cesium were introduced immediately after the accident by establishing a tentative limit for the contamination level. These regulations excluded or minimized the excessive internal radiation exposure in Japan.

pmc-12370934.title: Systematic selection of best performing mathematical models for in vitro gas production using machine learning across diverse feeds
pmc-12370934.creator: Hamed Ahmadi, Natascha Titze, Katharina Wild, Markus Rodehutscord
pmc-12370934.description: In vitro gas production (GP) is commonly used to evaluate ruminant feed, yet its accurate interpretation requires robust mathematical modeling. pmc-13413591.creator: Meng Cao, Zexin Wang, Yanggang Jia, Qingzhi Hu, Zhaoran Guan, Haofei Huang, Linjun Wang, Jian Huang
pmc-13413591.description: Li n+ and In p+ diffusion contacts were fabricated on p-type 12N high-purity germanium (HPGe) single crystals by vacuum evaporation of thin-film sources followed by solid-state thermal diffusion. pmc-13433236.title: Association between neutrophil percentage-to-albumin ratio and chronic subdural hematoma: a retrospective case-control study
pmc-13433236.creator: Guanda Han, Yifan Lv, Mingjie Wang, Tao Sun, Xiaohui Dong, Mingliang Deng, Hongjie Zhai, Hui Zhang, Lei Li
pmc-13433236.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the association between neutrophil percentage-to-albumin ratio (NPAR) and chronic subdural hematoma (CSDH), and evaluate its discriminative efficacy.MethodsClinical data of 87 CSDH patients and 130 healthy controls (2023–2025) were retrospectively analyzed. Logistic regression, ROC curves, bootstrap validation (1,000 iterations), VIF, and Hosmer-Lemeshow test were performed. Stratified analyses by age (<70 vs. ≥70 years) and sex assessed association robustness.
